The Eastern Continent, known as the Land of Legends. Escarth is the largest landmass in the known world. It is home to many diverse peoples and multiple kingdoms. The Kingdoms of Estor are divided by the natural boarder of the Blade and the Spine Peak Mountains.
Northern Kingdoms:
- [[The Winterlands]]
- [[Tamita]]
- [[Goliaca]]
Southern Kingdoms:
- [[Estor]]
- [[Calixos]]
- [[New Praetoria]]
- [[Arkonia]]
- [[The Freehold]]

Climate: The climate is continental ranging from far below zero in the north and warm summers in the south. The seasons are extended, meaning there are winters that can span multiple years and summers that do the same. The longest recorded winter was long ago in the Second Age, lasting 7 years. Generally everywhere but the most southern regions you will need to keep warm, with temperatures being around 50 degrees Fahrenheit.
